architecture.mechanism: Closed-loop PID control with variable frequency drive (VFD) airflow regulation to dynamically match charge air temperature and pressure conditions, reducing pressure drop and stabilizing air-fuel ratio.
architecture.intervention: Retrofit the 2021 Chevrolet Equinox fuel pump feed line with a closed-loop PID-controlled variable speed drive on the fuel pump, using manifold pressure and fuel rail pressure sensors as feedback to dynamically adjust pump speed and maintain target rail pressure under transient loads (acceleration, turning).
architecture.expected_effect: Stabilized fuel rail pressure and flow during transient maneuvers (e.g., turn-lane acceleration), preventing momentary fuel starvation that causes engine stall, analogous to the 6–8% efficiency gain and pressure-drop reduction (10 kPa to 1.2 kPa) shown for the charge air system.
architecture.falsification_test: On a chassis dynamometer, induce repeated turn-lane acceleration events while monitoring fuel rail pressure with a high-speed transducer; the intervention passes if pressure deviation from target remains within ±2% during all transients and no stall occurs across 50 trials, and fails if any stall or pressure sag greater than 5% below target is observed, compared to a baseline reproduction of the stall on the unmodified pump.
